portal_description:
The File Integrity Operator image update is available with the following changes:

Version 0.1.16:

* Add FileIntegrityStatus and NodeIntegrityStatus events.
* Fix log compression crash.
* AIDE daemon re-write.
* Handle the image upgrade case where the AIDE daemonSet has new VolumeMounts
defined.
* Handle the image upgrade case where new default component scripts are defined.
* Use the daemon's own service account. Add event permissions.
* No longer force-restart the daemonSet pods for a regular re-init. This now
only happens when a configuration/ds change is required.
* Use additional watch resources for the status controller, instead of a static timed re-queue.
